title: Load CSV data preserving leading zeros
instructions:
Write a Python function named load_players(csv_text) that accepts CSV content as a string and returns a pandas DataFrame. The CSV data to process is: player_id,fps
001,120
002,85
. Preserve player_id values as strings with leading zeros, and keep fps values numeric.
success_criteria: The returned DataFrame has exactly two rows.
fps column values are exactly [120, 85] and have a numeric dtype.
scope_note: This exercise does not resolve the GitHub issue or establish readiness to modify pandas internals.
requirements: Write a Python function named load_players(csv_text).
Accept CSV content as a string, not a file path.
Preserve player_id values as the strings 001 and 002.
checks: The returned DataFrame has two rows.
fps values equal [120, 85] and have a numeric dtype.
